product.title: Early-Bird Tasting Tour of Pike Place Market

description.text: Explore Pike Place Market before peak crowds on an early-access guided tasting tour. Sample smoked salmon, local chocolate, and market specialties while vendors prepare for the day in a quieter market setting.

highlights: Early-access Pike Place Market food tour
Tastings before peak market crowds arrive
Sample smoked salmon and local sweets

start.description: Meet at 1901 Western Ave D, Seattle, WA 98101.

end.description: Tour ends within Pike Place Market.

itineraryItems.description: Learn how the market evolved over more than a century while tasting local favorites.
